settings.heroSubtitle: Pushing boundaries in brand identity, editorial design, and digital experiences that leave lasting impressions.
settings.aboutParagraph1: We're a collective of designers, thinkers, and visual storytellers who believe that great design isn't just seen — it's felt. Every pixel, every curve, every color choice is deliberate.
settings.aboutParagraph2: From brand identities to immersive digital experiences, we bring ideas to life with precision and passion. Our work spans across industries, cultures, and mediums.
settings.designerBio1: I'm Alex — a multidisciplinary designer and creative director with over 12 years of experience turning abstract ideas into powerful visual narratives, spanning brand identity, web design and development, photography, and videography.
settings.designerBio2: From branding Fortune 500 companies to crafting indie album art, I approach every project with the same hunger: to create something that demands attention and refuses to be forgotten.
